      ...(data.timeBudgetMs !== undefined ? { timeBudgetMs: data.timeBudgetMs } : {}),
      ...(data.uiLeases !== undefined ? { uiLeases: data.uiLeases } : {}) };
    input = validate(applyData);
    const requestHash = hash({ request: { ...input, phase: 'apply', confirm: true }, planId: input.planId });
    const prior = await loadJournal(rootPath, input.requestId, deps.fs ?? fs);
    if (prior.writerActive) return { operation: 'references.refresh', schemaVersion: 1,
      requestId: input.requestId, planId: input.planId, invocationStatus: 'unknown', success: false,
      modelValidated: false, inProgress: prior.report?.inProgress ?? null,
      unavailableEvidence: ['existing request writer is active; no replay or lock theft'] };
    if (prior.report) {
      if (prior.report.requestHash !== requestHash) throw new Error('requestId already belongs to a different immutable apply request');
      return prior.report.result ? { ...prior.report.result, replayedReceipt: true } :
        { operation: 'references.refresh', schemaVersion: 1, requestId: input.requestId, planId: input.planId,
          invocationStatus: 'unknown', inProgress: prior.report.inProgress ?? null, replayedReceipt: true,
          unavailableEvidence: ['existing immutable request receipt has no settled result'] };
    }
    if (input.nativeFallback === 'qualifiedOnce') {
      const missing = plan.updates.filter(update =>
        (update.method === 'UpdateAllLatestCmd' || update.fallback === 'UpdateAllLatestCmd') &&
        !input.uiLeases?.[update.fileId]);
      if (missing.length) {
        return apply(client, input, plan, { ...deps, initialBlockers: missing.map(row => ({fileId:row.fileId,
          reason:'authorizedUiLeaseRequired'})) });
      }
    }
    const snapshot = await deps.step('graph', { ...input, phase: 'audit', policy: plan.policy }, input, context);
    const blockers = planFreshness(plan, snapshot);
    return apply(client, input, plan, { ...deps, initialSnapshot: snapshot, initialBlockers: blockers });
  }
  const readRequestHash = hash({ operation: 'references.refresh', request: { ...input, phase: input.phase } });
  const previous = await loadJournal(path.resolve(input.reportPath), input.requestId, deps.fs ?? fs);
  if (previous.writerActive) return { operation: 'references.refresh', schemaVersion: 1,
    requestId: input.requestId, root: input.root, invocationStatus: 'unknown', success: false,
    modelValidated: false, unavailableEvidence: ['existing request writer is active; no replay or lock theft'] };
  if (previous.report) {
    if (previous.report.requestHash !== readRequestHash) throw new Error('requestId already belongs to a different immutable read/plan request');
    return { ...previous.report.result, replayedReceipt: true };
  }
  const snapshot = await deps.step('graph', input, input, context);
  const plan = makePlan(snapshot, input);
  if (input.phase === 'audit') {
    const planned = { ...plan, invocationStatus: plan.blocked.length ? 'blocked' : 'complete',
      completed: [], skipped: plan.skipped, failed: [], notProcessed: [], inProgress: null,
      budgetExceeded: false, continuation: null, errors: [] };
    if ((plan.notPlanned.length || !plan.graphComplete) && planned.invocationStatus === 'complete') planned.invocationStatus = 'partial';
    planned.success = planned.invocationStatus === 'complete'; planned.modelValidated = true;
    return finishReadPhase(input, planned, deps);
  }
  if (input.phase === 'plan') {
    const root = path.resolve(input.reportPath);
    const planId = await writePlan(root, plan, deps.fs ?? fs);
    const result = { ...plan, phase: 'plan', planId,
      invocationStatus: plan.blocked.length ? 'blocked' : plan.notPlanned.length ? 'partial' : 'complete' };
    result.success = result.invocationStatus === 'complete'; result.modelValidated = true;
    return finishReadPhase(input, result, deps);
  }
  throw new Error('Unsupported references.refresh phase');
}

module.exports = { configure, validate, makePlan, dependencyOrder, staleBeforeStep, planFreshness, writePlan,
  readPlan, loadJournal, apply, execute };
